title: FRACTURED-SORRY-Bench: Framework for Revealing Attacks in Conversational Turns Undermining Refusal Efficacy and Defenses over SORRY-Bench (Automated Multi-shot Jailbreaks)
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness and safety of LLMs against multi-turn adversarial attacks (jailbreaking). It evaluates the models' ability to refuse harmful queries rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral judgment, or ethical philosophical frameworks.
